data.name: Fazilat
data.gender_notes: Fazilat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: God's Grace, Bestowal, Divine Favor. The name Fazilat carries the meaning “Favor, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Fazilat usually hope their child will grow to embody favor, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Fazilat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Favor, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fazilat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فضيلة
in_arabic.meaning: الفضيلة تعني الرفعة و العلو في الأخلاق و الفضل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفضيلة اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، و يعني الرفعة و العلو في الأخلاق و الفضل. و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني رفيعة و محمودة، و التي يرغب الكثيرون في تسمية بناتهم بها. و الفضيلة هي من صفات الله الحسنى، و هي تعبر عن العلو و الرفعة في الأخلاق و الأفعال.

in_urdu.name: فضیلت
in_urdu.meaning: فضیلت کا مطلب ہے اچھائی، فضل و کرم، اور خلق کی بلندی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فضیلت ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اچھائی، فضل و کرم، اور خلق کی بلندی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ فضل و کرم کی صفت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصطلاح میں جڑی ہوئی ہے، جو کہ 'فضل' سے نکلی ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فضل، کرم، اور اچھائی۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ज़ीलत
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ज़ीलत का अर्थ है अच्छाई, शालीनता और उच्च चरित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ज़ीलत एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है, जो कि अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है अच्छाई, शालीनता और उच्च चरित्र। यह नाम न केवल सुंदर है, बल्कि यह एक गहरे अर्थ को भी समेटे हुए है, जो कि किसी व्यक्ति की उच्च नैतिकता और अच्छे चरित्र को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: فضيلت
in_pashto.meaning: فضيلت د ښه والي، د کرم او د لوړو اخلاقو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فضيلت د عربي اصل يو نوم دی، چې د ښه والي، د کرم او د لوړو اخلاقو معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون فرهنگ کې ډیر اهمیت لري، او د دينی او ملی فخر ښکارندوی دی. دغه نوم د فضل او کرم د صفتونو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې په اسلامي دين کې ډیر ارزښت لري.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fazilat holds significant cultural importance in Islamic tradition, as it reflects the belief in the bounties and grace that Allah bestows upon His creation. It serves as a reminder of the divine blessings and favors that we receive every day, often unbeknownst to us. In various Islamic societies, the name is often given to children as a way to highlight the importance of being grateful for Allah's blessings and remembering His favor.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fazilat holds great significance for Muslims as it emphasizes the importance of recognizing and being thankful for Allah's blessings and favors. It serves as a reminder of the importance of cultivating a deep sense of gratitude towards Allah for the various blessings that He has bestowed upon us. Furthermore, it encourages individuals to strive towards living a life that is pleasing to Allah, as a means of attracting more of His blessings and favors. Ultimately, the name Fazilat underscores the Islamic belief that all good things come from Allah, and that we should be ever-mindful of His generosity and divine presence in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Favor, Blessing" symbolizes God's Grace, Bestowal, Divine Favor. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fazilat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of favor, blessing.
